# J15 session 2 — polite and verbose: indirect questions, multi-clause turns, hedges
Good morning, everyone! I'm Jack, it's nice to meet you all.
I was wondering whether any of you have been on one of these expeditions before?
Sorry, but could you tell me a little about yourself, Giselle?
That's really interesting, thank you. Malcolm, would you mind introducing yourself as well?
And Tonya, if you don't mind, what about you?
Would anyone happen to know where exactly we're headed today?
I see. And what is the actual purpose of the expedition, if I may ask?
Just out of curiosity, who is carrying the camera?
Sorry, what did you mean by that?
How do you know that, if you don't mind me asking?
How is everyone feeling this morning?
Malcolm, I hope you don't mind me asking, but are you nervous at all?
Why do you say that?
Is this your first day at ASYNC, Tonya, or have you been here a while?
Have you ever been inside the Complex yourself?
Could someone remind me what Maxwell told us to do after the briefing?
And what should we be doing right now?
Will all of us be going to Equipment Staging together, or are we splitting up?
Do you two know each other already, Giselle and Malcolm?
That's good to hear. Would you say you're looking forward to this, Giselle?
Malcolm, could you tell me what Tonya said earlier?
Thank you, that's very helpful.
Who exactly is Maxwell, and what does he do here?
What is the Threshold, if you don't mind me asking?
Out of curiosity, when are we supposed to leave?
Could you tell me what the startup materials are for?
And where are the startup materials going?
Sorry, I wasn't asking you, I was asking Tonya.
I'm sorry, I didn't quite catch that. Could you say it again?
What does ASYNC actually do as a company?
Is it alright if I ask whether any of you are tired?
It seems like a lovely morning for it.
Tonya, how long have you been with ASYNC?
And have you been on an expedition before?
Giselle, same question.
Would you mind telling me what you're doing right now, Malcolm?
I appreciate it. I think that's everyone introduced now.
So where do we go next, if you don't mind me asking?
And is everyone coming along?
Thank you all very much.
